title: german bratwurst wrap
description: a dense, satisfying german-inspired dish filled with nutty flavors, perfect for a lazy sunday afternoon

ingredients.name: grated carrot
ingredients.notes: shredded or grated from 1 medium carrot

instructions: fill a large pot with 1 cup of water and bring to a boil
steam 2 leaf lettuce leaves in the pot for 30 seconds, until slightly tender
remove the lettuce leaves from the pot and set aside
grill or cook the bratwurst links according to package instructions
in a large bowl, combine the gochugaru-spiced sauerkraut, grated carrot, chopped parsley, and sesame seeds
warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 10 seconds
assemble the wrap by spreading 1 tsp of mustard on the tortilla, then topping with a cooked bratwurst link
add 1/4 cup of the sauerkraut mixture on top of the bratwurst
place the steamed lettuce leaves on top of the sauerkraut mixture
fold the bottom half of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly
